title: 해양경찰위원회 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Removal of Members)
(1) Where a member is removed from office pursuant to Article 7 (3) of the Act because the member becomes unable to perform his or her duties due to a serious physical or mental disability, a resolution of the Committee shall be required.
(2) A resolution under paragraph (1) shall be requested by the chairperson or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries.
